'''Jakir Halcyon''' was a [[Human/Legends|human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[third Galactic War]]. He was a member of the [[Corellian Jedi]], himself hailing from [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], and was slain alongside the [[Selonian/Legends|Selonian]] Jedi [[Seldin]] on Corellia during [[Battle of the Meridian Complex|the battle]] there.<ref name="Onslaught" />

==Powers and abilities==
Halcyon was skilled in his use of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] and could use it to [[Telekinesis/Legends|slam]] his opponents in combat while using the Force to [[Force valor|augment his strength]] to provide him with a greater advantage. He was also able to [[Force healing/Legends|heal]] himself and others and could enter a healing trance to recover his strength.<ref name="Onslaught" /> Halcyon was also able to [[Force sense/Legends|sense]] those around him and could pinpoint [[Disturbance in the Force/Legends|disturbances in the Force]].

==Equipment==
Halcyon wore the [[Jedi apparel/Legends|green traditional robes]] of the Corellian Jedi.<ref name="Onslaught" />
